Powhatan Confederacy.name: Wahunsenacawh
Powhatan Confederacy.note: Built the confederacy of about 30 Algonquian peoples in Virginia.
Powhatan Confederacy.note_zh: 联合弗吉尼亚约30个阿尔冈昆部落，组成波瓦坦联盟。

people.name: Juan Ponce de León
people.known_for: Spanish conquistador who led the first European expedition to Florida in 1513.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙征服者，1513年率领第一支欧洲探险队到达佛罗里达并为其命名。

people.name: Giovanni da Verrazzano
people.known_for: Italian explorer who sailed the Atlantic coast for France in 1524 and entered New York Bay.
people.known_for_zh: 为法国效力的意大利探险家，1524年考察北美大西洋沿岸，最早进入纽约湾。

people.name: Álvar Núñez Cabeza de Vaca
people.name_zh: 阿尔瓦·努涅斯·卡韦萨·德巴卡
people.known_for: Spanish explorer who survived a shipwreck and walked for eight years across Texas and northern Mexico.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙探险家，船难后在得克萨斯和墨西哥北部徒步漂泊八年，留下珍贵的印第安人见闻。

people.name: Jacques Cartier
people.known_for: French explorer who sailed up the St. Lawrence River in 1535 and gave Canada its name.
people.known_for_zh: 法国探险家，1535年溯圣劳伦斯河而上，“加拿大”一名由他的记录传开。

people.name: Hernando de Soto
people.known_for: Spanish conquistador who led the first European expedition deep into the American Southeast and crossed the Mississippi.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙征服者，率领欧洲人首次深入美国东南部，并渡过密西西比河。

people.name: Francisco Vázquez de Coronado
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·巴斯克斯·德科罗纳多
people.known_for: Spanish explorer who searched the Southwest for the Seven Cities of Gold from 1540 to 1542.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙探险家，1540年至1542年在美国西南部寻找传说中的“黄金七城”。

people.name: Pedro Menéndez de Avilés
people.name_zh: 佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德阿维莱斯
people.known_for: Spanish admiral who founded St. Augustine in Florida in 1565, the oldest continuously settled European town in the US.
people.known_for_zh: 西班牙海军将领，1565年建立佛罗里达圣奥古斯丁，这是美国境内最古老的欧洲人定居城镇。

people.name: Walter Raleigh
people.known_for: English courtier who sponsored the Roanoke colony, England's first attempt to settle North America.
people.known_for_zh: 英国廷臣，资助了罗阿诺克殖民地，这是英国在北美建立殖民地的首次尝试。

people.name: Martin Frobisher
people.known_for: English seaman who made three voyages to Arctic Canada in the 1570s seeking the Northwest Passage.
people.known_for_zh: 英国航海家，1570年代三次航行到加拿大北极地区，寻找西北航道。

people.name: John White
people.known_for: English artist whose watercolours of the Algonquian people are the earliest English pictures of North America.
people.known_for_zh: 英国画家，罗阿诺克殖民地总督，他描绘阿尔冈昆人的水彩画是英国人最早的北美图像。

people.name: Thomas Harriot
people.known_for: English scientist who described the land and people of Virginia after the Roanoke voyage of 1585.
people.known_for_zh: 英国科学家，1585年随船到罗阿诺克，记录了弗吉尼亚的土地、物产和居民。

works.title: A Briefe and True Report of the New Found Land of Virginia
works.title_zh: 关于新发现的弗吉尼亚之地的简要真实报告

British American colonies.name: William III
British American colonies.note: Ruled jointly with Mary II until 1694.

people.name: Samuel de Champlain
people.known_for: French explorer who founded Quebec in 1608 and is called the Father of New France.
people.known_for_zh: 法国探险家，1608年建立魁北克城，被称为“新法兰西之父”。

people.name: John Smith
people.known_for: English soldier who led the Jamestown colony through its hard early years.
people.known_for_zh: 英国军人，在詹姆斯敦殖民地最艰难的早期担任领导，使殖民地得以存续。

people.name: Pocahontas
people.known_for: Daughter of Chief Powhatan who married the colonist John Rolfe and helped bring a brief peace to Virginia.
people.known_for_zh: 波瓦坦酋长之女，嫁给殖民者约翰·罗尔夫，促成了弗吉尼亚印第安人与殖民者的短暂和平。

people.name: Henry Hudson
people.known_for: English navigator who explored the Hudson River in 1609 and Hudson Bay in 1610.
people.known_for_zh: 英国航海家，1609年考察哈德逊河，1610年进入哈德逊湾。

people.name: Squanto
people.known_for: Patuxet man who taught the Pilgrims to plant corn and acted as their interpreter.
people.known_for_zh: 帕图克西特族印第安人，教清教徒移民种植玉米，并担任他们与印第安人之间的翻译。

people.name: William Bradford
people.known_for: Pilgrim leader who governed Plymouth Colony for some 30 years and wrote its history.
people.known_for_zh: 清教徒移民领袖，担任普利茅斯殖民地总督约30年，并撰写了殖民地的历史。

people.name: John Winthrop
people.known_for: Puritan governor of Massachusetts Bay who called the colony a 'city upon a hill'.
people.known_for_zh: 马萨诸塞湾殖民地的清教徒总督，称殖民地应成为“山巅之城”。

people.name: Roger Williams
people.known_for: Puritan minister who founded Rhode Island on religious freedom and the separation of church and state.
people.known_for_zh: 清教徒牧师，创建罗得岛殖民地，主张宗教自由和政教分离。

people.name: Anne Hutchinson
people.known_for: Puritan woman banished from Massachusetts for challenging the colony's ministers.
people.known_for_zh: 清教徒女性宗教人物，因挑战马萨诸塞的牧师权威而被逐出殖民地。

people.name: Anne Bradstreet
people.known_for: The first published poet of the English colonies in North America.
people.known_for_zh: 北美英国殖民地第一位出版诗集的诗人。

works.title: The Tenth Muse Lately Sprung Up in America

people.name: Metacomet
people.known_for: Wampanoag leader, called King Philip by the English, who led the native war of 1675 to 1676 against New England.
people.known_for_zh: 万帕诺亚格族首领，英国人称“菲利普王”，1675年至1676年领导印第安人对新英格兰作战。

people.name: William Penn
people.known_for: Quaker who founded Pennsylvania in 1681 as a colony of religious tolerance.
people.known_for_zh: 贵格会信徒，1681年创建宾夕法尼亚殖民地，推行宗教宽容。

people.name: Jacques Marquette
people.known_for: French Jesuit who with Louis Jolliet explored the upper Mississippi in 1673.
people.known_for_zh: 法国耶稣会传教士，1673年与若利埃一起考察密西西比河上游。

people.name: René-Robert Cavelier, Sieur de La Salle
people.known_for: French explorer who sailed down the Mississippi to its mouth in 1682 and claimed Louisiana for France.
people.known_for_zh: 法国探险家，1682年沿密西西比河航行到河口，宣布路易斯安那归属法国。

people.name: Louis de Buade de Frontenac
people.known_for: Governor of New France who expanded the fur trade and defended Quebec against the English in 1690.
people.known_for_zh: 新法兰西总督，扩展毛皮贸易，1690年成功保卫魁北克，击退英军。

people.name: Cotton Mather
people.known_for: Influential Puritan minister and writer, linked to the Salem witch trials and to early smallpox inoculation.
people.known_for_zh: 有影响的清教徒牧师和作家，与塞勒姆审巫案有关，也是天花接种的早期倡导者。

people.name: Jonathan Edwards
people.known_for: Preacher and theologian of the Great Awakening revival.
people.known_for_zh: 神学家和布道家，北美“大觉醒”宗教复兴运动的代表人物。

works.title: Sinners in the Hands of an Angry God
works.title_zh: 落在愤怒上帝手中的罪人

people.name: Louis-Joseph de Montcalm
people.name_zh: 路易-约瑟夫·德·蒙卡尔姆
people.known_for: French commander in North America who was killed defending Quebec in 1759.
people.known_for_zh: 法军在北美的总司令，1759年保卫魁北克时阵亡。

people.name: James Wolfe
people.known_for: British general who won the Battle of the Plains of Abraham at Quebec in 1759 and died in the battle.
people.known_for_zh: 英国将领，1759年在魁北克的亚伯拉罕平原战役中获胜，本人战死。

Kingdom of Great Britain.name: George III
Kingdom of Great Britain.note: King of the colonies until independence was recognised in 1783.
Kingdom of Great Britain.note_zh: 直到1783年英国承认美国独立前统治北美殖民地。

people.name: Benjamin Franklin
people.known_for: Printer, scientist and diplomat who proved lightning is electricity and won French support for independence.
people.known_for_zh: 印刷商、科学家和外交家，证明闪电是电，并为独立战争争取到法国的支持。

people.name: George Washington
people.known_for: Commander of the Continental Army who won the War of Independence and became the first US president.
people.known_for_zh: 大陆军总司令，领导赢得独立战争，后来成为美国第一任总统。

people.name: Thomas Jefferson
people.known_for: Main author of the Declaration of Independence and later third US president.
people.known_for_zh: 《独立宣言》的主要起草人，后来担任美国第三任总统。

works.title: Notes on the State of Virginia

people.name: John Adams
people.known_for: Massachusetts lawyer who led the push for independence in Congress and became the second US president.
people.known_for_zh: 马萨诸塞律师，在大陆会议中力主独立，后来担任美国第二任总统。

people.name: Samuel Adams
people.known_for: Boston organiser of resistance to British taxes, linked to the Boston Tea Party of 1773.
people.known_for_zh: 波士顿反英税运动的组织者，与1773年波士顿倾茶事件密切相关。

people.name: Patrick Henry
people.known_for: Virginia orator remembered for the cry 'Give me liberty, or give me death!'
people.known_for_zh: 弗吉尼亚演说家，以“不自由，毋宁死”的名言著称。

people.name: Paul Revere
people.known_for: Silversmith whose midnight ride in 1775 warned that British troops were coming to Lexington.
people.known_for_zh: 银匠，1775年连夜骑马报信，警告英军正向列克星敦开来。

people.name: James Madison
people.known_for: Father of the US Constitution and of the Bill of Rights, later fourth US president.
people.known_for_zh: 被称为“美国宪法之父”，起草《权利法案》，后来担任美国第四任总统。

people.name: Nathanael Greene
people.known_for: Continental Army general who led the successful southern campaign.
people.known_for_zh: 大陆军将领，指挥南方战役，逐步收复南部各州。

people.name: Benedict Arnold
people.known_for: American general who won at Saratoga but then plotted to hand West Point to the British.
people.known_for_zh: 美军将领，在萨拉托加战役中立功，后来密谋把西点要塞交给英军，成为叛国者的代名词。

people.name: Pontiac
people.known_for: Odawa leader of the native war of 1763 against British forts around the Great Lakes.
people.known_for_zh: 渥太华族首领，1763年领导五大湖地区印第安人攻打英国要塞。

people.name: Joseph Brant
people.known_for: Mohawk leader who fought for Britain and led his people to settle in Canada after the war.
people.known_for_zh: 莫霍克族首领，在独立战争中支持英国，战后率族人迁居加拿大。

people.name: Guy Carleton
people.known_for: British governor of Quebec who backed the Quebec Act of 1774 and held Canada against the American invasion.
people.known_for_zh: 英国魁北克总督，推动1774年《魁北克法案》，并击退美军对加拿大的进攻。

people.name: Phillis Wheatley
people.known_for: Enslaved African woman in Boston who became the first African American to publish a book of poems.
people.known_for_zh: 波士顿的非洲裔女奴，成为第一位出版诗集的非裔美国人。

works.title: Poems on Various Subjects, Religious and Moral

people.name: John Singleton Copley
people.known_for: Leading portrait painter of colonial Boston.
people.known_for_zh: 殖民地时期波士顿最重要的肖像画家，后移居伦敦。

people.name: Benjamin Rush
people.known_for: Philadelphia physician who signed the Declaration of Independence and pioneered American medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 费城医生，《独立宣言》签署人之一，美国医学和精神病学的先驱。

people.name: Alexander Hamilton
people.known_for: First US Treasury Secretary, who set up the national bank and the federal finances.
people.known_for_zh: 美国第一任财政部长，创建国家银行，奠定联邦财政体系。

people.name: John Marshall
people.known_for: Chief Justice who established the Supreme Court's power to strike down laws in Marbury v. Madison.
people.known_for_zh: 美国首席大法官，通过马伯里诉麦迪逊案确立了最高法院的司法审查权。

people.name: Meriwether Lewis
people.known_for: Led with William Clark the expedition of 1804 to 1806 across the continent to the Pacific.
people.known_for_zh: 与克拉克共同率领1804年至1806年的远征队，横穿北美大陆到达太平洋。

people.name: William Clark
people.known_for: Co-leader of the Lewis and Clark Expedition, who mapped the American West.
people.known_for_zh: 刘易斯与克拉克远征的领导者之一，绘制了美国西部地图。

people.name: Sacagawea
people.known_for: Shoshone woman who guided and interpreted for the Lewis and Clark Expedition.
people.known_for_zh: 肖肖尼族女子，为刘易斯与克拉克远征队担任向导和翻译。

people.name: Alexander Mackenzie
people.known_for: Scottish fur trader who in 1793 made the first crossing of North America north of Mexico.
people.known_for_zh: 苏格兰毛皮商人，1793年首次横越墨西哥以北的北美大陆到达太平洋。

people.name: Tecumseh
people.known_for: Shawnee leader who united many tribes against American expansion and fought beside Britain in 1812.
people.known_for_zh: 肖尼族首领，联合众多部落抵抗美国扩张，在1812年战争中与英国并肩作战。

people.name: Isaac Brock
people.known_for: British general who defended Upper Canada in the War of 1812 and died at Queenston Heights.
people.known_for_zh: 英国将领，在1812年战争中保卫上加拿大，战死于昆斯顿高地。

people.name: Sequoyah
people.known_for: Cherokee silversmith who created a writing system for the Cherokee language.
people.known_for_zh: 切罗基族银匠，独自创制了切罗基文字，使本族人迅速识字。

people.name: Eli Whitney
people.known_for: Inventor of the cotton gin of 1793, which made cotton growing in the South hugely profitable.
people.known_for_zh: 1793年发明轧棉机，使南方棉花种植获利巨大，也加深了对奴隶制的依赖。

people.name: Robert Fulton
people.known_for: Engineer whose steamboat Clermont began regular service on the Hudson in 1807.
people.known_for_zh: 工程师，1807年他的汽船“克莱蒙特号”在哈德逊河上开始定期航行。

people.name: Samuel Morse
people.known_for: Painter and inventor who built the electric telegraph and Morse code, first used in 1844.
people.known_for_zh: 画家和发明家，研制电报机和莫尔斯电码，1844年首次实用通报。

people.name: Noah Webster
people.known_for: Lexicographer whose dictionary of 1828 set American English spelling.
people.known_for_zh: 词典编纂家，1828年出版的词典确立了美式英语的拼写。

works.title: An American Dictionary of the English Language

people.name: Washington Irving
people.known_for: One of the first American writers famous in Europe, author of Rip Van Winkle.
people.known_for_zh: 最早在欧洲成名的美国作家之一，代表作有《瑞普·凡·温克尔》。

people.name: James Fenimore Cooper
people.known_for: Novelist of the American frontier.
people.known_for_zh: 描写美国边疆生活的小说家。

people.name: John James Audubon
people.known_for: Naturalist and painter who drew life-size pictures of nearly all North American birds.
people.known_for_zh: 博物学家和画家，以原尺寸描绘了几乎所有北美鸟类。

people.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson
people.known_for: Essayist and leader of Transcendentalism who urged Americans to trust themselves.
people.known_for_zh: 散文家，超验主义运动的领袖，提倡自立和个人精神。

people.name: Henry David Thoreau
people.known_for: Writer who lived simply by Walden Pond and argued for civil disobedience.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，在瓦尔登湖畔过简朴生活，提出“公民不服从”思想。

people.name: Edgar Allan Poe
people.known_for: Poet and story writer who shaped the horror tale and invented the detective story.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人和小说家，开创了侦探小说，是恐怖小说的大师。

works.title: The Murders in the Rue Morgue

people.name: Nathaniel Hawthorne
people.known_for: Novelist who wrote of guilt and sin in Puritan New England.
people.known_for_zh: 小说家，描写清教徒新英格兰的罪恶与良心。

people.name: Herman Melville
people.known_for: Novelist whose whaling epic Moby-Dick is a classic of American literature.
people.known_for_zh: 小说家，捕鲸史诗《白鲸》是美国文学经典。

people.name: Harriet Beecher Stowe
people.known_for: Writer whose anti-slavery novel Uncle Tom's Cabin stirred the North before the Civil War.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，反奴隶制小说《汤姆叔叔的小屋》在内战前深深震动了北方社会。

people.name: Frederick Douglass
people.known_for: Escaped slave who became the leading Black abolitionist speaker and writer.
people.known_for_zh: 逃亡奴隶出身，成为最著名的黑人废奴运动演说家和作家。

works.title: Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass
works.title_zh: 弗雷德里克·道格拉斯自述

people.name: Harriet Tubman
people.known_for: Escaped slave who led many others to freedom on the Underground Railroad.
people.known_for_zh: 逃亡女奴，通过“地下铁路”多次冒险带领奴隶逃往自由。

people.name: Joseph Smith
people.known_for: Founder of the Latter Day Saint movement (Mormonism).
people.known_for_zh: 后期圣徒运动（摩门教）的创始人。

people.name: Louis-Joseph Papineau
people.known_for: Leader of the French Canadian reformers whose cause led to the Lower Canada Rebellion of 1837.
people.known_for_zh: 法裔加拿大改革派领袖，其主张引发了1837年下加拿大起义。

people.name: Abraham Lincoln
people.known_for: President who led the Union through the Civil War and freed the slaves, assassinated in 1865.
people.known_for_zh: 美国总统，领导联邦赢得南北战争，颁布《解放黑人奴隶宣言》，1865年遇刺身亡。

people.name: Robert E. Lee
people.known_for: Commander of the Confederate army of Northern Virginia, who surrendered at Appomattox in 1865.
people.known_for_zh: 南方邦联北弗吉尼亚军团司令，1865年在阿波马托克斯投降。

people.name: Ulysses S. Grant
people.known_for: Union general who won at Vicksburg and forced Lee's surrender, later US president.
people.known_for_zh: 联邦将领，攻克维克斯堡，迫使李将军投降，后来担任美国总统。

people.name: William Tecumseh Sherman
people.known_for: Union general who took Atlanta and marched through Georgia to the sea in 1864.
people.known_for_zh: 联邦将领，1864年攻占亚特兰大，进行“向海洋进军”。

people.name: Stonewall Jackson
people.known_for: Confederate general famous for his Shenandoah Valley campaign.
people.known_for_zh: 南方邦联将领，以谢南多厄河谷战役闻名。

people.name: Walt Whitman
people.known_for: Poet of free verse who nursed wounded soldiers in the Civil War.
people.known_for_zh: 自由诗的开创者，内战中在华盛顿看护伤兵。

people.name: Emily Dickinson
people.known_for: Reclusive poet who wrote nearly 1,800 short poems, most published after her death.
people.known_for_zh: 隐居的女诗人，写下近1800首短诗，大多在她去世后才出版。

people.name: Clara Barton
people.known_for: Civil War nurse who founded the American Red Cross in 1881.
people.known_for_zh: 内战时期的护士，1881年创立美国红十字会。

people.name: Mathew Brady
people.known_for: Photographer whose team made the best-known pictures of the Civil War.
people.known_for_zh: 摄影师，他的团队拍摄了南北战争最著名的照片。

people.name: George-Étienne Cartier
people.known_for: French Canadian leader who with Macdonald brought Quebec into the Canadian Confederation of 1867.
people.known_for_zh: 法裔加拿大政治领袖，与麦克唐纳一起促成魁北克加入1867年加拿大联邦。

people.name: Louis Riel
people.known_for: Métis leader of the Red River Resistance of 1869 that led to the province of Manitoba.
people.known_for_zh: 梅蒂人领袖，领导1869年红河起义，促成马尼托巴省的建立，1885年被处死。

people.name: Sitting Bull
people.known_for: Lakota holy man and leader whose warriors defeated Custer at Little Bighorn in 1876.
people.known_for_zh: 拉科塔族精神领袖，1876年他的战士在小大角战役中击败卡斯特。

people.name: Crazy Horse
people.known_for: Lakota war leader at the Battle of the Little Bighorn.
people.known_for_zh: 拉科塔族军事首领，在小大角战役中立下大功。

people.name: George Armstrong Custer
people.name_zh: 乔治·阿姆斯特朗·卡斯特
people.known_for: US cavalry officer killed with his men at the Little Bighorn in 1876.
people.known_for_zh: 美国骑兵军官，1876年在小大角战役中全军覆没。

people.name: Thomas Edison
people.known_for: Inventor of the phonograph and a practical electric light, who built the first power station.
people.known_for_zh: 发明家，发明留声机和实用电灯，建立了第一座商业发电站。

people.name: Alexander Graham Bell
people.name_zh: 亚历山大·格拉汉姆·贝尔
people.known_for: Scottish-born inventor who patented the telephone in 1876.
people.known_for_zh: 苏格兰出生的发明家，1876年获得电话专利。

people.name: Nikola Tesla
people.known_for: Serbian-American inventor of the alternating current motor and power system.
people.known_for_zh: 塞尔维亚裔美国发明家，发明交流电动机和交流输电系统。

people.name: Wilbur Wright
people.known_for: With his brother Orville built the first powered aeroplane, flown at Kitty Hawk in 1903.
people.known_for_zh: 与弟弟奥维尔一起制造了第一架动力飞机，1903年在基蒂霍克试飞成功。

people.name: Henry Ford
people.known_for: Carmaker whose Model T and moving assembly line made cars affordable for ordinary people.
people.known_for_zh: 汽车制造商，T型车和流水装配线使普通人也买得起汽车。

people.name: Andrew Carnegie
people.known_for: Steel magnate who gave most of his fortune to libraries, schools and peace.
people.known_for_zh: 钢铁大王，后来把大部分财富捐给图书馆、学校和和平事业。

people.name: John D. Rockefeller
people.known_for: Founder of Standard Oil, the richest man of his age and a great philanthropist.
people.known_for_zh: 标准石油公司创始人，当时世界首富，也是著名的慈善家。

people.name: J. P. Morgan
people.known_for: Banker who dominated Wall Street and organised giant firms such as US Steel.
people.known_for_zh: 银行家，主宰华尔街，组建了美国钢铁公司等巨型企业。

people.name: Mark Twain
people.known_for: Humorist and novelist of life on the Mississippi.
people.known_for_zh: 幽默作家和小说家，描写密西西比河畔的生活。

people.name: Henry James
people.known_for: Novelist of Americans meeting the old society of Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 小说家，擅长描写美国人与欧洲旧社会的相遇。

people.name: Jack London
people.known_for: Popular writer of adventure in the Klondike and the wild.
people.known_for_zh: 以克朗代克淘金和荒野冒险为题材的畅销作家。

people.name: William James
people.known_for: Harvard philosopher and psychologist, a founder of pragmatism.
people.known_for_zh: 哈佛哲学家和心理学家，实用主义哲学的创始人之一。

people.name: John Dewey
people.known_for: Pragmatist philosopher and educational reformer who lectured in China from 1919 to 1921.
people.known_for_zh: 实用主义哲学家和教育改革家，1919年至1921年曾在中国讲学。

people.name: W. E. B. Du Bois
people.known_for: Sociologist and civil rights leader who co-founded the NAACP.
people.known_for_zh: 社会学家和民权领袖，全国有色人种协进会的创始人之一。

people.name: Booker T. Washington
people.known_for: Former slave who built the Tuskegee Institute and urged education and self-help for Black Americans.
people.known_for_zh: 奴隶出身的教育家，创办塔斯基吉学院，倡导黑人通过教育和自助求发展。

people.name: Susan B. Anthony
people.known_for: Leader of the campaign for women's right to vote.
people.known_for_zh: 美国妇女选举权运动的领袖。

people.name: Jane Addams
people.known_for: Social reformer who founded Hull House in Chicago and won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1931.
people.known_for_zh: 社会改革家，在芝加哥创办赫尔馆，1931年获诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Geronimo
people.known_for: Apache leader who resisted US and Mexican forces until his surrender in 1886.
people.known_for_zh: 阿帕奇族首领，长期抵抗美国和墨西哥军队，1886年投降。

people.name: Winslow Homer
people.known_for: Painter of the sea and American country life.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，以描绘大海和美国乡村生活著称。

people.name: Lucy Maud Montgomery
people.known_for: Canadian author of the much loved Anne of Green Gables.
people.known_for_zh: 加拿大作家，著有深受喜爱的《绿山墙的安妮》。

United States.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
United States.name_zh: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福

Canada.name: R. B. Bennett
Canada.name_zh: 理查德·贝德福德·贝内特

people.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
people.name_zh: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福
people.known_for: President who fought the Great Depression with the New Deal and led the US in the Second World War.
people.known_for_zh: 美国总统，以“新政”应对大萧条，领导美国参加第二次世界大战。

people.name: Eleanor Roosevelt
people.known_for: First Lady and campaigner who later chaired the drafting of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
people.known_for_zh: 美国第一夫人和社会活动家，后来主持起草《世界人权宣言》。

people.name: George C. Marshall
people.known_for: US Army chief of staff in the Second World War, later author of the Marshall Plan.
people.known_for_zh: 二战时期美国陆军参谋长，后来提出援助欧洲复兴的“马歇尔计划”。

people.name: Dwight D. Eisenhower
people.known_for: Supreme Allied Commander who led the D-Day landings in 1944, later US president.
people.known_for_zh: 盟军最高司令，指挥1944年诺曼底登陆，后来担任美国总统。

people.name: Douglas MacArthur
people.known_for: US general who led the Allied campaign in the Southwest Pacific and the occupation of Japan.
people.known_for_zh: 美国将领，指挥西南太平洋战区盟军作战，战后主持对日本的占领。

people.name: Chester W. Nimitz
people.known_for: Commander of the US Pacific Fleet who won at Midway and across the Central Pacific.
people.known_for_zh: 美国太平洋舰队司令，赢得中途岛海战并指挥中太平洋作战。

people.name: J. Robert Oppenheimer
people.known_for: Physicist who directed the Los Alamos laboratory that built the first atomic bombs.
people.known_for_zh: 物理学家，领导洛斯阿拉莫斯实验室研制出第一批原子弹，被称为“原子弹之父”。

people.name: Edwin Hubble
people.known_for: Astronomer who showed that there are other galaxies and that the universe is expanding.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，证明银河系外还有其他星系，并发现宇宙正在膨胀。

people.name: Frederick Banting
people.known_for: Canadian doctor who co-discovered insulin in 1921 and won the Nobel Prize.
people.known_for_zh: 加拿大医生，1921年参与发现胰岛素，获诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。

people.name: Norman Bethune
people.known_for: Canadian surgeon who served the Eighth Route Army in China and died there in 1939.
people.known_for_zh: 加拿大外科医生，来华支援八路军，1939年在中国殉职，毛泽东写《纪念白求恩》。

people.name: Charles Lindbergh
people.known_for: Aviator who made the first solo non-stop flight across the Atlantic in 1927.
people.known_for_zh: 飞行员，1927年首次单人不着陆飞越大西洋。

people.name: Amelia Earhart
people.known_for: First woman to fly solo across the Atlantic, lost over the Pacific in 1937.
people.known_for_zh: 第一位单人飞越大西洋的女飞行员，1937年在太平洋上空失踪。

people.name: F. Scott Fitzgerald
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯·斯科特·菲茨杰拉德
people.known_for: Novelist of the Jazz Age.
people.known_for_zh: “爵士时代”的代表作家。

people.name: Ernest Hemingway
people.known_for: Novelist of spare, plain prose who won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1954.
people.known_for_zh: 以简洁文风著称的小说家，1954年获诺贝尔文学奖。

works.title: The Old Man and the Sea

people.name: William Faulkner
people.known_for: Nobel-winning novelist of the American South.
people.known_for_zh: 描写美国南方的小说家，1949年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: John Steinbeck
people.known_for: Novelist of poor farm workers in the Great Depression.
people.known_for_zh: 描写大萧条时期贫苦农工的小说家，1962年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Langston Hughes
people.known_for: Leading poet of the Harlem Renaissance.
people.known_for_zh: 哈莱姆文艺复兴运动的代表诗人。

people.name: Louis Armstrong
people.known_for: Trumpeter and singer who made jazz an art of the solo.
people.known_for_zh: 小号手和歌手，爵士乐史上最有影响力的音乐家之一。

people.name: Walt Disney
people.known_for: Animator who created Mickey Mouse and the first full-length animated film.
people.known_for_zh: 动画师，创造了米老鼠，制作了第一部长篇动画电影。

works.title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
works.title_zh: 白雪公主和七个小矮人

people.name: Frank Lloyd Wright
people.place_zh: 威斯康星州斯普林格林
people.known_for: Architect of buildings in harmony with nature.
people.known_for_zh: 建筑师，倡导与自然和谐的“有机建筑”。

people.name: Georgia O'Keeffe
people.known_for: Painter of large flowers and New Mexico landscapes.
people.known_for_zh: 以大幅花卉和新墨西哥风景画闻名的画家。

people.name: Martin Luther King Jr.
people.known_for: Baptist minister who led the nonviolent civil rights movement and gave the 'I Have a Dream' speech.
people.known_for_zh: 浸信会牧师，领导非暴力民权运动，发表《我有一个梦想》演说，1968年遇刺。

people.name: Rosa Parks
people.known_for: Seamstress whose refusal to give up her bus seat in 1955 started the Montgomery bus boycott.
people.known_for_zh: 女裁缝，1955年拒绝在公交车上给白人让座，引发蒙哥马利公交抵制运动。

people.name: Malcolm X
people.known_for: Black Muslim leader who preached Black pride and self-defence.
people.known_for_zh: 黑人穆斯林领袖，倡导黑人自尊与自卫，1965年遇刺。

people.name: John F. Kennedy
people.known_for: President during the Cuban Missile Crisis who launched the Moon programme, assassinated in Dallas in 1963.
people.known_for_zh: 美国总统，经历古巴导弹危机，启动登月计划，1963年在达拉斯遇刺。

people.name: George F. Kennan
people.known_for: Diplomat who framed the policy of containing the Soviet Union.
people.known_for_zh: 外交官，提出遏制苏联的战略，奠定美国冷战政策。

people.name: Henry Kissinger
people.known_for: Secretary of State who made the secret trip to Beijing in 1971 that opened US relations with China.
people.known_for_zh: 美国国务卿，1971年秘密访华，为中美关系正常化打开大门。

people.name: Neil Armstrong
people.known_for: Apollo 11 astronaut and the first person to walk on the Moon, in 1969.
people.known_for_zh: 阿波罗11号宇航员，1969年成为第一个踏上月球的人。

people.name: Jonas Salk
people.known_for: Virologist who developed the first effective polio vaccine in 1955.
people.known_for_zh: 病毒学家，1955年研制出第一种有效的脊髓灰质炎疫苗。

people.name: John von Neumann
people.known_for: Mathematician who designed the stored-program architecture of modern computers.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，提出现代计算机的存储程序结构，被称为“计算机之父”。

people.name: Claude Shannon
people.known_for: Engineer at Bell Labs who founded information theory in 1948.
people.known_for_zh: 贝尔实验室工程师，1948年创立信息论。

people.name: Richard Feynman
people.known_for: Physicist who helped create quantum electrodynamics.
people.known_for_zh: 物理学家，量子电动力学的奠基人之一，1965年获诺贝尔物理学奖。

people.name: Rachel Carson
people.known_for: Biologist whose book on pesticides started the modern environmental movement.
people.known_for_zh: 生物学家，揭露农药危害的著作开启了现代环保运动。

people.name: Milton Friedman
people.known_for: Economist of the free market and monetarism.
people.known_for_zh: 经济学家，货币主义和自由市场理论的代表，1976年获诺贝尔经济学奖。

people.name: John Rawls
people.known_for: Harvard philosopher of justice as fairness.
people.known_for_zh: 哈佛政治哲学家，提出“作为公平的正义”。

people.name: Betty Friedan
people.known_for: Writer who sparked second-wave feminism.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，其著作掀起第二波女权运动。

people.name: J. D. Salinger
people.known_for: Novelist of teenage alienation.
people.known_for_zh: 小说家，描写青少年的迷惘与反叛。

people.name: Arthur Miller
people.known_for: Playwright of ordinary people crushed by society.
people.known_for_zh: 剧作家，描写被社会压垮的普通人。

people.name: Jack Kerouac
people.known_for: Leading writer of the Beat Generation.
people.known_for_zh: “垮掉的一代”的代表作家。

people.name: Toni Morrison
people.known_for: Novelist of African American life, Nobel Prize in Literature 1993.
people.known_for_zh: 描写非裔美国人生活的小说家，1993年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Elvis Presley
people.known_for: Singer called the King of Rock and Roll.
people.known_for_zh: 歌手，被称为“摇滚乐之王”，绰号“猫王”。

people.name: Andy Warhol
people.known_for: Leading artist of pop art.
people.known_for_zh: 波普艺术的代表人物。

people.name: Jackson Pollock
people.known_for: Abstract expressionist painter famous for his drip paintings.
people.known_for_zh: 抽象表现主义画家，以“滴画”闻名。

people.name: Marshall McLuhan
people.known_for: Canadian media theorist who said 'the medium is the message'.
people.known_for_zh: 加拿大传播学家，提出“媒介即讯息”和“地球村”。

people.name: Glenn Gould
people.known_for: Canadian pianist famous for his Bach recordings.
people.known_for_zh: 加拿大钢琴家，以演奏巴赫作品闻名，代表录音为《哥德堡变奏曲》。

people.name: Steve Jobs
people.known_for: Co-founder of Apple who brought the Macintosh, iPod and iPhone to market.
people.known_for_zh: 苹果公司联合创始人，推出麦金塔电脑、iPod和iPhone等改变世界的产品。

people.name: Ruth Bader Ginsburg
people.known_for: Supreme Court justice from 1993 and a leading voice for gender equality in law.
people.known_for_zh: 1993年起任美国最高法院大法官，长期致力于法律上的性别平等。

people.name: Colin Powell
people.known_for: General who led the US military in the Gulf War and became the first Black Secretary of State.
people.known_for_zh: 美国将领，海湾战争时任参谋长联席会议主席，后成为首位非裔国务卿。

people.name: Madeleine Albright
people.known_for: First woman to serve as US Secretary of State, from 1997 to 2001.
people.known_for_zh: 美国第一位女国务卿，1997年至2001年在任。

people.name: Philip Roth
people.known_for: Novelist of Jewish American life and of postwar America.
people.known_for_zh: 描写美国犹太人生活和战后美国社会的小说家。

people.name: Cormac McCarthy
people.known_for: Novelist of violence and survival in the American Southwest.
people.known_for_zh: 小说家，描写美国西南部的暴力与生存。

people.name: Alice Munro
people.known_for: Canadian master of the short story, Nobel Prize in Literature 2013.
people.known_for_zh: 加拿大短篇小说大师，2013年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Leonard Cohen
people.known_for: Canadian poet and singer-songwriter.
people.known_for_zh: 加拿大诗人和创作歌手，代表作《哈利路亚》。

people.name: Michael Jackson
people.known_for: Singer and dancer called the King of Pop.
people.known_for_zh: 歌手和舞蹈家，被称为“流行音乐之王”。

people.name: Gordon Moore
people.known_for: Co-founder of Intel who predicted that chips would double in power every two years.
people.known_for_zh: 英特尔公司联合创始人，提出芯片集成度约每两年翻一番的“摩尔定律”。
